motor_body.name: TEFC Induction Motor 7.5 kW
motor_body.torque: Foot bolts M12 at 80 Nm, diagonal sequence
motor_body.tool_required: 19 mm socket, dial indicator for realignment
motor_body.service_interval: Insulation resistance test annually, bearing regrease every 4000 h
motor_body.safety: Lock out and tag out at the panel. Verify zero volts at the terminals before you open anything.
motor_body.notes: Always recheck coupling alignment after refitting a motor. Nine out of ten repeat bearing failures are misalignment, not a bad bearing.

motor_terminal_box.name: Motor Terminal Box
motor_terminal_box.torque: Gland nuts hand tight plus quarter turn, lid screws 3 Nm
motor_terminal_box.service_interval: Inspect gasket and gland seals annually
motor_terminal_box.safety: Live terminals. Lock out first. Assume it is energised until you have measured it.
motor_terminal_box.notes: A perished lid gasket lets moisture in and shows up months later as a tripped earth leakage breaker on damp mornings.

motor_fan.name: Motor Cooling Fan
motor_fan.service_interval: Inspect for cracks at every service
motor_fan.safety: Never run the motor with the cowl off.
motor_fan.notes: A cracked or missing blade unbalances the rotor and reads on a vibration meter exactly like a failing bearing.

fan_cowl.name: Fan Cowl
fan_cowl.safety: This is the guard. If it is off, the motor does not run.
fan_cowl.notes: A cowl packed with dust is the most common cause of a motor running hot in a dusty plant.

coupling.name: Flexible Spider Coupling
coupling.torque: Hub grub screws 12 Nm onto the shaft flat
coupling.tool_required: 5 mm hex key, dial indicator or laser alignment tool
coupling.service_interval: Inspect the spider every 2000 h, realign after any motor or pump removal
coupling.safety: Guard must be refitted before the set is run. Rotating coupling, no exceptions.
coupling.notes: Crumbling rubber dust under the guard means misalignment. Replace the spider AND fix the alignment, or the new one lasts a fortnight.

shaft.name: Pump Shaft (EN8)
shaft.torque: Impeller nut 45 Nm, left hand thread
shaft.service_interval: Runout checked at every seal change
shaft.notes: Runout over 0.05 mm at the seal face will eat mechanical seals no matter how carefully you fit them.

bearing_housing.name: Bearing Housing
bearing_housing.service_interval: Oil change every 4000 h, level checked weekly
bearing_housing.safety: Hot after running. Let it cool.
bearing_housing.notes: Cloudy oil in the sight glass means water ingress past the lip seal. Change the oil and the seal together or you will be back next month.

bearing_front.name: Front Bearing 6308-2RS
bearing_front.torque: Interference fit. Heat to 110 C in an induction heater, never hammer.
bearing_front.service_interval: Replace at 25000 h or at first vibration alarm
bearing_front.notes: This is the one that fails first, because it takes the radial load from the impeller and it sits closest to any seal that is weeping.

bearing_rear.name: Rear Bearing 6306-2RS
bearing_rear.torque: Interference fit. Heat to 110 C, never hammer.
bearing_rear.service_interval: Replace in pairs with the front bearing
bearing_rear.notes: Always replace both. Fitting one new bearing against one worn one just moves the vibration.

mechanical_seal.name: Mechanical Seal 35 mm (SiC/Carbon)
mechanical_seal.torque: Set screws 6 Nm after setting the working length
mechanical_seal.tool_required: Seal setting clips, IPA and lint-free cloth
mechanical_seal.service_interval: Replace at every casing opening. They are not reusable.
mechanical_seal.safety: Handle faces by the edges only. A fingerprint on the seal face will make it leak.
mechanical_seal.notes: Never run this pump dry, even for two seconds. The faces are lubricated by the liquid and they cook instantly without it.

pump_casing.name: Volute Casing (Cast Iron)
pump_casing.torque: Casing bolts 55 Nm, crossed sequence, in three passes
pump_casing.service_interval: Wear ring clearance checked at every overhaul
pump_casing.safety: Drain and depressurise before opening. Confirm the line is isolated on BOTH sides.
pump_casing.notes: Wear ring clearance over 0.8 mm costs you head and efficiency long before anything sounds wrong.

impeller.name: Closed Impeller 180 mm (Bronze)
impeller.torque: Retaining nut 45 Nm, LEFT HAND thread
impeller.notes: Rounded or pitted vane tips mean cavitation or dry running. Trim marks on the outer diameter are from a previous impeller trim - record them before you fit a full size replacement or the motor will overload.

casing_cover.name: Casing Cover Plate
casing_cover.notes: Never reuse the gasket. It costs eighty rupees and it is the reason the joint weeps a week later.

suction_flange.name: Suction Flange DN80
suction_flange.torque: Flange bolts 60 Nm, crossed, three passes
suction_flange.safety: Confirm the line is isolated and drained before you crack the first bolt.
suction_flange.notes: Air leaking IN through this joint causes exactly the same symptoms as cavitation, and people chase the impeller for weeks instead.

discharge_flange.name: Discharge Flange DN65
discharge_flange.torque: Flange bolts 55 Nm, crossed, three passes
discharge_flange.safety: This side holds pressure. Verify the discharge valve is shut and the line is vented.
discharge_flange.notes: Pipe strain here transmits straight into the bearing housing. If the flange does not meet square without forcing, fix the pipework, not the pump.

drain_plug.name: Casing Drain Plug 1/2 BSP
drain_plug.safety: Contents may be hot or aggressive. Know what the pump was handling before you open it.
drain_plug.notes: Cheapest part on the machine and the most common source of a mystery puddle.
